decisions.reason: The large bulk container is close to the firm's core reusable packaging range, has its own website page, and the firm's in-house R&D lets it interpret early results and refine the product.
The valve builds on the firm's bulk-container expertise and complements its containers, so the firm's existing knowledge and R&D support assimilating feedback and improving it.

The take-back service extends the firm's pooling and supply-chain service know-how in line with its sustainability and service strategy, though its lower web visibility makes its future slightly less certain.
